data.question_title: Which of the following is the most suitable drying agent for ammonia gas ?
data.explanation_txt:
As ammonia is a basic gas, it cannot be dried by passing it through concentrated sulphuric acid or phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5), as it reacts with them to form ammonium sulphate or ammonium phosphate respectively.

Anhydrous Calcium chloride also cannot be used for drying ammonia gas as it forms ammoniates.

So quick lime is the suitable one.

For denominator to be non-zero and square root to have positive content, \({(x-1)(x-4)} > 0\)

\(x <1\) \(<0\) \(<0\) \(>0\)
\(1< x < 4 \) \(>0\) \(<0\) \(<0\)
\(x > 4\) \(>0\) \(>0\) \(>0\)

From the table, \({(x-1)(x-4)} > 0\) is satisfied for \(x<1\) and \(x>4\).

So, the domain is \({(-\infty,1) \cup (4,\infty)}\)

data.question_title: When 2 ampere current is passed through a tangents galvanometer, it gives a deflection of 30\(^\circ\). For 60\(^\circ\) deflection, the current must be
data.explanation_txt:
According to tangent law, \(I=K \tan \theta\)
\(\therefore \cfrac{I_{2}}{I_{1}}=\cfrac{\tan \theta_{2}}{\tan \theta_{1}} \Rightarrow I_{2}=I_{1}\left(\cfrac{\tan \theta_{2}}{\tan \theta_{1}}\right)\)
\(\cfrac{I_{2}}{I_{1}}=\cfrac{\tan \theta_{2}}{\tan \theta_{1}} \Rightarrow I_{2}=2\left(\cfrac{\tan 60^{\circ}}{\tan 30^{\circ}}\right)\)
\(\therefore I_{2}=6 \mathrm{Amp}\)

data.question_title: In the twentieth century, architects in large cities designed structures in a way that reduced noise and yet made living as comfortable as possible. They used such techniques as making walls hollow and filling this wall space with materials that absorb noise. Thick carpets and heavy curtains were used to cover floors and windows. Air conditioners and furnaces were designed to filter air through sound proofing materials. However, after much time and effort had been spent in making building less noisy, it was discovered that people also reacted adversely to the lack of sound. Now architects are designing structures which reduce undesirable noise but retain the kind of noise that people seem to need.
